item.title: Service Update: Ethos Data Connect [resolved]
item.description:
AWS performed an unscheduled minor upgrade of the PostgreSQL database, resulting in brief database downtime. During this window, Customer Data Connect pipeline runs experienced a momentary impact.
All services are now operating normally.

item.title: Service Update: Experience and Data Connect [resolved]
item.description: Ellucian has identified and resolved the issue that was temporarily affecting some users on the Experience Dashboard. Some Data Connect jobs were also interrupted or did not start at the scheduled time. Service has been restored to normal. Access to Ethos, Data Connect, Insights, and EIP may have been temporarily impacted during this time.

item.title: ILP - Message processing [resolved]
item.description: Ellucian Engineers remediated an issue impacting ILP processing, the system stabilized, message processing resumed at normal rates, and the backlog was cleared of all actionable messages. We will continue to closely monitor performance.

item.title: Ethos API calls - Intermittent slow performance [resolved]
item.description: Some customers experienced intermittent slow response times for Ethos API calls. Ellucian engineers investigated and confirmed that response times have recovered. We will continue to closely monitor the environment.

item.title: Experience Cards Interruption [resolved]
item.description: Ellucian engineers resolved an issue impacting Experience cards. Normal system performance was restored and closely monitored overnight, engineers will continue to monitor the service.

item.title: CLOUDFLARE SERVICE ISSUE [resolved]
item.description: We closely monitored the widespread issue that Cloudflare was experiencing today. While we are unaware of any impacts to Ellucian SaaS or Cloud systems, it was possible that you may have experienced some intermittent issues until Cloudflare resolved the issue. Cloudflare updated that they implemented a fix and presently Cloudflare services are operating normally, they are no longer observing elevated errors or latency across the network. If you have any issues please submit a case to support. Thank you.

item.title: ELLUCIAN INSIGHTS POPULATION JOBS INTERRUPTION [resolved]
item.description: Ellucian engineers have resolved the issue impacting Insights population jobs. Normal system performance has been restored.

item.title: Microsoft Azure issue impacting customer connectivity to some services [resolved]
item.description: Ellucian is aware of an issue reported by Microsoft that Azure Front Door experienced issues resulting in a loss of connectivity to some services. Microsoft updated that they took remediation actions to restore access to the Azure management portal, they continue to see signs of recovery as they route traffic through health nodes. They anticipate full mitigation within the next four hours. Ellucian will continue to monitor. Please submit a ticket if any additional issues are encountered. Microsoft will continue to provide updates via https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status.

item.title: AWS OUTAGE US-EAST-1 [resolved]
item.description: All Ellucian cloud services have been restored. We continue to monitor AWS for further issues.

item.title: ILP PROCESSING ISSUE [resolved]
item.description: Engineering teams remediated the issue impacting ILP real-time and bulk job processing, ILP is fully operational.

item.title: Ellucian Experience Degraded Performance [resolved]
item.description: The intermittent latency issues have been fully resolved and Experience is fully operational.
